vulnerability.name: USN-8798-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that GStreamer Good Plugins incorrectly parsed certain MRF files. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-18295, CVE-2026-18296)  It was discovered that GStreamer Good Plugins incorrectly parsed certain PNG files. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-18298)  DongHyeon Hwang discovered that GStreamer Good Plugins incorrectly handled certain RTP packets. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-18299)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in GStreamer Good Plugins.
